about_the_game:
Observa is a relaxing space-photography game about building up your own backyard observatory. Point your telescope into the sky, discover celestial objects, and capture beautiful astrophotography shots. Sell your best prints, unlock new upgrades, and gradually turn your tiny setup into a powerful stargazing machine.

Upgrade your lenses, expand your zoom range, improve tracking, unlock additional print slots, and even decorate with photo frames to display your favorite captures. Every picture has value — from planets and stars to rare events like supernovas or quasars.

Whether you're chasing the perfect shot or simply enjoying the peaceful atmosphere of night sky exploration, Observa turns stargazing into a cozy progression adventure.

Features

  • 📸 Take astrophotography shots of stars, planets, nebulae, and rare cosmic events

  • 🔭 Upgrade your home observatory with better zoom, tracking, print slots, and more

  • 🖼️ Print and display your favorite photos using unlockable frames

  • 💰 Sell prints to fund new equipment and expand your setup

  • ✨ Relaxing, atmospheric gameplay focused on discovery and creativity

  • 🎯 Simple, satisfying progression without complexity or grind
